title: How to Watch the Emmys in India: Time, Channels and Top Nominees
excerpt: The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards air on September 14 in the US — and stream live in India in the early hours of September 15 on JioHotstar. Here's the full timing, the nominees to watch, and the Indian names in the mix.
body:
• The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards take place on Monday, September 14, 2026, at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles — 8 pm ET / 5 pm PT in the US.
  • Indian viewers can stream the show live exclusively on JioHotstar: red carpet from 4:30 am IST, with the main ceremony at 5:30 am IST on September 15.
  • Law & Order: SVU star Mariska Hargitay hosts for the first time, and recorded a special "Namaste India" message for viewers ahead of the ceremony.
  • HBO's The Pitt leads with 25 nominations; Hacks follows with 24, a record for a comedy series. Michael J. Fox receives the Bob Hope Humanitarian Award, and Priyanka Chopra's Heads of State is nominated for Outstanding Television Movie.

When and where to watch in India

Television's biggest night lands in the small hours for Indian viewers. The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards will be held on Monday, September 14, 2026, at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles, kicking off at 8 pm ET / 5 pm PT in the US.

In India, the ceremony streams live exclusively on JioHotstar. Red carpet and pre-show coverage begins at 4:30 am IST on September 15, with the main awards starting at 5:30 am IST, according to the Times of India and Storyboard18. Those who cannot watch live will be able to stream the ceremony on demand afterwards. In the US, the awards air on NBC and stream on Peacock.

A first-time host

Mariska Hargitay steps into hosting duties for the first time, returning the ceremony to a solo-host format. Best known as Detective Olivia Benson on Law & Order: Special Victims Unit, she is an Emmy winner herself and recently picked up two more Emmys for My Mom Jayne, a documentary about her late mother, actor Jayne Mansfield, per Storyboard18.

"Bringing important stories into the light has been the heartbeat of my career. It's my great honour to host the 78th Emmy Awards, in the 100th birthday year of my beloved NBC, and celebrate this extraordinary community of storytelling."

— Mariska Hargitay

Hargitay also addressed Indian audiences directly ahead of the ceremony: "Namaste India, don't miss television's biggest night. 78th Emmy Awards, streaming live only on JioHotstar."

The frontrunners

HBO Max's medical drama The Pitt enters the night as the nominations leader with 25 nods, including Outstanding Drama Series, with Noah Wyle leading a strong showing across the acting categories, according to the Times of India. Hacks, which just concluded its fifth and final season, follows with 24 nominations — the highest single-year total ever recorded by a comedy series. A final-season win could also give Jean Smart another addition to her Emmy tally.

Other heavy hitters include Widow's Bay and Apple's Pluribus, with DTF St. Louis, The Bear, All Her Fault, The Gilded Age, Abbott Elementary, Only Murders in the Building and Euphoria rounding out the field, per Storyboard18. Indian viewers can catch up on many of them first — JioHotstar already streams nominated series including Hacks, DTF St. Louis, The Bear, The Gilded Age and Euphoria, according to Cinema Express.

One of the night's most emotional moments: Michael J. Fox receives the Bob Hope Humanitarian Award for his decades of Parkinson's disease research and advocacy. Since it was established in 2002, the award has been given only six times — past recipients include Oprah Winfrey, George Clooney, Sean Penn, and last year's honorees Ted Danson and Mary Steenburgen. Fox also earned his 19th Emmy nomination this year for his guest turn on Apple TV's Shrinking, per Filmfare.

Diaspora Angle

The Indian connection to this year's Emmys runs through Priyanka Chopra Jonas, whose action film Heads of State — co-starring John Cena and Idris Elba — is nominated for Outstanding Television Movie, per the Times of India and the Daily Jagran. Her attendance had not been confirmed as of publication.

Huma Qureshi is set to be the only actress from the Indian subcontinent at the ceremony, taking part in pre-Emmy events including Gold House's third annual One House Toast to the Emmys in Los Angeles, per the Daily Jagran. In the acting races themselves, no Indian-origin actor picked up a nomination this year — Supriya Ganesh and Shabana Azeez of The Pitt were both overlooked, according to The Wrap.

What's Next

The big question of the night is whether The Pitt converts its nominations lead into drama-category dominance, or whether the industry rallies behind Hacks for a final-season farewell. For Indian viewers, the move is simple: set the alarm for 5:30 am IST on September 15 — or skip the early wake-up and stream the full ceremony on demand on JioHotstar later in the day.

nri_angle: Priyanka Chopra's Heads of State is nominated for Outstanding Television Movie and Huma Qureshi is the only Indian actress attending, while JioHotstar's exclusive live stream makes the ceremony accessible to Indian and diaspora viewers.
